candidate.definition_en: Severe or intense (of pain/illness); showing a perceptive understanding.
candidate.explanation_ar: وصف للألم الشديد جداً، أو للملاحظة الدقيقة والذكية 'بصيرة حادة'.

senses.definition_en: Very serious, severe, or intense, especially of an illness, pain, or problem.
senses.definition_ar: شديد أو حاد جداً (للألم، المرض، أو الأزمات).
examples: She suffered from acute pain in her back.

senses.definition_en: Showing a perceptive understanding or having keen senses.
examples: He has an acute sense of hearing.
The report provides an acute analysis of the political situation.
She suffered from acute pain in her back.
He has an acute sense of hearing.
The report provides an acute analysis of the political situation.
